title: A DEL character inside a comment
notes: Comment text is `#` followed by non-break characters (production 75), and production 27 takes them from the printable characters (production 1). DEL (U+007F) is not printable, so it is an error, as in any other part of the stream outside a quoted scalar. DEL is the first character that cannot belong: line 1, column 4 (`#`, a space, `c`, then DEL).

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted any character but a line break in a comment.
